name: Rafferty's Rules
description:
Rafferty's Rules was an Australian television drama series which ran from 1987 to 1990 on the Seven Network.

Rafferty's Rules was one of the first programs undertaken by the Seven Network's then new in-house drama unit, going into production in May 1985 as "a 15-part courtroom drama". The program had started out as a pilot episode, recorded in early 1984 with the actor Chris Haywood in the lead role. When the pilot episode was remounted later in 1984, Chris Haywood wasn't available and the lead role was re-cast to John Wood. This second recording was eventually broadcast as the program's first episode.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Michael Aloysius Rafferty starts his new job as Stipendiary Magistrate of Manly Local Court.

videos.title: Win Some, Lose Some
videos.overview: Rafferty's estranged wife Joanne arrives in Sydney to discuss a few things and he is anxious. Meanwhile, Paulyne has a crisis of conscience when she has to act for a man in an assault case.

videos.title: Truth to Tell
videos.overview: Rafferty deals with a young prostitute and U.S. government officials apply to extradite one of their citizens.

videos.title: The Free Life
videos.overview: Rafferty is angry when a drugs case he was listed to deal with is suddenly moved to another court and confronts the Chief Magistrate about the matter.

videos.title: The Women
videos.overview: Rafferty is forced to examine his attitude towards women.

videos.title: Rafferty and the Srangers Among Us
videos.overview: Rafferty feels alone with his recent move to the city.

videos.title: Sin with Gold
videos.overview: Rafferty has no choice but to dismiss a big drug case.

videos.title: Looking Good
videos.overview: Rafferty hears two cases about people's desire to look good.

videos.title: Reason to Believe
videos.overview: A young prostitute decides to defend herself against a soliciting charge.

videos.title: Mates and Brothers
videos.overview: An Italian father and his brother plant a bomb in Rafferty's chambers.

videos.title: Sticks
videos.overview: Rafferty investigates what appears to be an accidental death by drowning.

videos.title: Stray Cat
videos.overview: A young drifter comes before Rafferty's court for being in possession of a cat skin.

videos.title: Invasion of Privacy
videos.overview: Rafferty's cases reflect people invading other people's privacy.

videos.title: Rafferty and the Rough Diamond
videos.overview: Rafferty finds that people and things are not always as they seem.

videos.title: Public Image
videos.overview: Rafferty realises that the media makes innocent people look like monsters.

videos.title: Time Out
videos.overview: Work pressures get to much for Paulyne and a love affair seems the answer.

videos.title: To the Whistle
videos.overview: Flicker's replacement finds he has to play it by Rafferty's rules.

videos.title: Make My Day
videos.overview: Double standards are apparent in a case that comes before Rafferty.

videos.title: Kids
videos.overview: Rafferty confronts painful parallels at home when his kids arrive out of the blue.

videos.title: Dark Side of the Moon
videos.overview: There is an uneasy atmosphere around Rafferty's court when Flicker returns.

videos.title: Suspicious Minds
videos.overview: Rafferty's court is thrown into turmoil by a mysterious thief in Rafferty's office.

videos.title: Solidarity
videos.overview: Rafferty is confronted by a case involving vandalism on a building site.

videos.title: Prejudice and Pride
videos.overview: Rafferty gets involved in a case of racial prejudice.

videos.title: Out of the Past
videos.overview: Rafferty is confronted by the past when his older brother visits him.

videos.title: The Hit
videos.overview: The police are called in to protect Rafferty when he starts receiving threats.

videos.title: Freedom of Choice
videos.overview: Rafferty, embroiled in what local papers call "the punk drug squatters assault case", faces a housing crisis of his own and deals with the by-products of a cashless society: credit card junkies.

videos.title: Nine Tenths of the Law
videos.overview: Michael wrestles with the concept of possession after the discovery of Aboriginal remains creates a conflict of ownership between the state and the Indigenous community.

videos.title: Freedom
videos.overview: Michael is caught between a rock and a hard place when he is forced to decide the fate of a young boy whose doctors believe is sick, but whose parents are refusing further tests on religious grounds.

videos.title: Those Who Can
videos.overview: Fulvio learns that his teacher and idol isn't quite the perfect magistrate that he thought after he takes over when Michael falls ill.

videos.title: Sense of Duty
videos.overview: The courthouse becomes the centre of the fallout from a Secret Intelligence Agency training exercise.

videos.title: One for the Road
videos.overview: Gibson faces his past after a series of alcohol-related prosecutions force him to confront the reasons he gave up drinking.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: A series of sexual assaults has consequences for the courthouse when the police fit up suspects and Paulyne is attacked in her own home.

videos.title: Horse Play
videos.overview: Pauline finds that her personal life is mirroring her professional life when her former lover Gavin reappears and announces that he is getting married, just as she is defending a woman who refuses to accept that her marriage is over.

videos.title: Truth's a Dog
videos.overview: Paulyne accuses an insurance company of racism when they report a Lebanese man to the police after he claims his precious rings were stolen just days after taking out a policy.

videos.title: The Great Divide
videos.overview: Michael, Paulyne and Gibson find their ethics challenged when they deal with a man accused of raping his wife; however, it soon becomes apparent to all that the case is far more sinister than they ever could have imagined.

videos.title: Quanity of Mercy
videos.overview: Rafferty is confronted with the limitations of the law when it comes to dispensing justice.

videos.title: Peace of Mind
videos.overview: The courthouse finds itself becoming caught up in the deadly web of a cult. Michael is shocked when he goes on an early morning run and discovers the body of a young woman washed up on the beach.

videos.title: Thursday the Twelfth
videos.overview: Michael takes responsibility for a foreign woman after she shows up on his doorstep.

videos.title: Friends and Neighbours
videos.overview: A heatwave frays tempers at the courthouse when everyone arrives at work to find the air-conditioning broken.

videos.title: The Fleet's In
videos.overview: The personal and the professional converge for Flicker when the anti-nuclear group his son is involved in begins protesting the arrival of nuclear warships.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Rafferty's 6-year-old son goes missing.

videos.title: Crispin's Day
videos.overview: The Bard comes into the courtroom when an elderly man reciting Shakespeare is arrested for busking without a licence.

videos.title: Mum's the Word
videos.overview: Michael's hopes of reuniting with his estranged wife are dashed when Joanne reveals that she has come to visit to end their relationship, and then their son falls ill.

videos.title: Brief Candles
videos.overview: An unexpected tragedy forces Paulyne to re-evaluate her life; meanwhile she struggles to remain objective while defending a man accused of manslaughter over the death of a pedestrian.

videos.title: The Deep End
videos.overview: New Legal Aid solicitor Lisa Blake starts work at the courthouse; however, she soon finds herself coming into conflict with Michael when she grandstands in the courtroom, then fails to fully prepare a case in mitigation for a defendant.

videos.title: A Matter of Circumstances
videos.overview: A journalist sets out to prove that corruption exists in Rafferty's court.

videos.title: Waifs and Strays
videos.overview: Lisa continues to have problems settling in, with her abrasive nature putting Michael offside.

videos.title: The Beast
videos.overview: Lisa begins to wonder whether evil does exist when she defends a sociopath.

videos.title: Systems
videos.overview: The entire courthouse struggles to cope when Michael is forced to decide whether a man accused of murder has a case to answer.

videos.title: Those Who Can't
videos.overview: Lisa defends a young man who seems to be heading for the same life of crime as his father once did, but she refuses to believe Ray Brown's claims that the father's intentions are anything but honourable.

videos.title: Blood Relations
videos.overview: Michael's world is turned upside down after learning that he has a twenty-two year old daughter from a previous relationship.

videos.title: Star Quality
videos.overview: Flicker's prosecution against a young policeman who has broken the law is complicated when he begins to recognise that something even more suspicious is going on.

videos.title: Private Lives
videos.overview: More than one life is on the line after a former children's television performer is charged with propositioning young boys for sex in the changing rooms of a local swimming pool.

videos.title: You Can Never Tell
videos.overview: A criminal nicknamed 'The Hairy Bandit' is causing havoc and the courthouse is feeling the impact.

videos.title: The Affair That Never Was
videos.overview: Michael's divorce from Joanne officially comes through, just as former Public Solicitor Paulyne Gray reappears in his life after a six month absence.

videos.title: Curtains for Ringo
videos.overview: Michael considers his attitudes towards both politics and rural life after his cousin comes to the city, having now been elected to Parliament and holding very different opinions to Michael.

videos.title: Security
videos.overview: Michael sees the law from another perspective after he becomes the key witness in Flicker's prosecution against an arsonist.

videos.title: That Old Black Magic
videos.overview: Michael begins to wonder if someone is trying to put a spell on him after a number of suspicious run-ins with a member of a religious commune.

videos.title: The Plague
videos.overview: Lisa confronts the prejudices of society when she defends a man with AIDS who has committed an armed robbery in order to ensure his wife's future following his death.

videos.title: In For a Penny
videos.overview: Michael is drawn into the world of a struggling young family after he witnesses a woman being hit by a car.

videos.title: Out of Line
videos.overview: Lisa finds herself at odds with her colleagues when she defends an anti-nuclear activist whose family and the police are determined to have detained for his own safety.

videos.title: One for Us
videos.overview: Rafferty decides to expose a Chilean military attaché following charges for torturing political dissidents in Chile.

videos.title: Politburo
videos.overview: Flicker is horrified after he discovers just what conditions are faced by those in the police cells awaiting trial.

videos.title: One Consideration With Another
videos.overview: Racial tensions erupt when two Asian men are accused of murder, while Michael questions his capacity as a magistrate after an act of leniency has dire consequences.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Flicker and Lisa find themselves dealing with a particularly challenging court case when a girl alleges that she was raped by her father four years earlier.

videos.title: The Book of Love
videos.overview: Lisa defends a singer who has beaten his wife, but her personal involvement in the case is made more difficult when he brings a gun into the courthouse.

videos.title: On the Barricades
videos.overview: Michael revisits his past as a university radical and conscientious objector when he is forced to decide the fate of a man who he once protested alongside.

videos.title: Funny Peculiar
videos.overview: Flicker confronts his own prejudices when he prosecutes a case involving the assault of a female impersonator; however, it is Michael who finds himself at the centre of a controversy after the verdict is given.

videos.title: Whatever Gets You Through the Night
videos.overview: Lisa is drawn into an organisation known as Life Force after a man is arrested for break and enter and assault.

videos.title: Whistling in the Dark
videos.overview: Flicker finds himself wandering into a murky world of corruption when he prosecutes a case against a police officer who has broken the law and where the key witness is a serial whistleblower.

videos.title: Blood, Sweat and Paycheques
videos.overview: Fulvio and Sandra's marriage comes close to breaking point after Sandra is arrested for shoplifting.

videos.title: Home Again Kathleen
videos.overview: Michael, Flicker and Lisa are dragged into a murky political world when they discover that the conflict between the British and the Irish is alive and well in Sydney.

videos.title: Driven to It
videos.overview: An act of vandalism by the member of an animal rights group leaves Michael becoming emotionally involved with the accused's mother.

videos.title: A Fair Day's Work
videos.overview: A man seeks Lisa's help when he is sacked after complaining about the work conditions; however, she soon finds herself defending him when he assaults his former boss.

videos.title: Lies
videos.overview: Lisa is drawn to an attractive young lawyer; however, she is forced into an ethical dilemma when his personal life unravels.

videos.title: Consciousness Raising
videos.overview: The feminist movement comes to the courthouse when a prominent feminist runs a group of pigs through the shop of a man accused of sexual harassment.

videos.title: Free of Passion
videos.overview: Flicker finds himself at the crossroads of a major life decision after he falls in love with a young female Constable, but his excitement at finding new love may see him lose it all.

videos.title: Many Happy Returns
videos.overview: A convicted criminal whose ex-wife is about to marry a police officer comes before the court accused of assault.

videos.title: In Custody
videos.overview: Lisa assists a young woman whose boyfriend has been arrested; however, she is horrified when she learns that he has been detained without charge and suspects that the police are fitting him up because he is Aboriginal.

videos.title: Lost Empires
videos.overview: Lisa fights to save an Indian couple who are facing deportation, only to discover that the collapse of the British Empire means that they have no real home to go back to.

videos.title: The Sea, the Sea
videos.overview: Michael and Flicker befriend the beachcomber and poet, Snowy White; however, their admiration is crushed when it begins to appear that Snowy may be guilty of murder.

videos.title: Up, Up and Away
videos.overview: Lisa is charmed by a client accused of appropriating money from elderly women; however, Michael and Flicker cause conflict when they question her judgement.

videos.title: Punch Ups
videos.overview: A prominent radio host has been charged with brawling. Michael is faced with the consequences of his judgements when he sentences a man accused of assault, only to later learn that the man's employer has sacked him.

videos.title: Best and Brightest
videos.overview: Michael is reunited with an old classmate in the lead-up to a school reunion; however, he is left wondering if they've come very far at all since the schoolyard.

videos.title: Unaccompanied Bark
videos.overview: An elderly journalist is arrested for shoplifting.

videos.title: Guilty
videos.overview: Michael is consumed by guilt after he hits a man with his car; however he starts to wonder if maybe there are deeper issues at play when he seeks guidance on how to deal with his feelings.
